purpose: Teach: 閉塞/南方/先駆け/先取り/英訳/下宿/検知/絶叫

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、血管の閉塞、つまり閉塞性疾患の医学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered medical research on vascular blockage — occlusive disease, that is — in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Calm teacherly opening, clearly enunciated, a gentle confirming lift on the tag.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、南方戦線、つまり南方諸島の戦史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — and I covered war-history research on the southern front, the southern islands, in my paper.
lines.style: Prompt earnest reply, quickening with quiet enthusiasm as he names his topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新技術の先駆け、つまり先駆け企業の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered research on the pioneers of new technology — the pioneering companies — didn't you.
lines.style: Reflective, unhurried, giving the key term a moment of air before moving on.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、市場の先取り戦略の経営学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered management research on market-preempting strategy in my paper.
lines.style: Eager and precise, the technical term delivered with a small proud emphasis.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、文学作品の英訳の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered historical research on the English translation of literary works, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm even cadence, mildly curious, inviting him onward with the closing tag.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦前の下宿、つまり下宿文化の社会学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered sociological research on prewar lodging houses — boarding culture — in my paper.
lines.style: Animated but controlled, warming to the subject, the words coming a touch faster.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、放射線検知器、つまり検知技術の工学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered engineering research on radiation detectors — detection technology — didn't you.
lines.style: Steady and precise, ticking down the list, a hint of approval underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦争被害者の絶叫の口承記録研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered research on the oral records of war victims' screams in my paper.
lines.style: Voice dropping with the weight of the topic, slower, sincere to the end.
